title: Everyday Muslim - Pray tracker

One of the key features of the app is that you can see who has prayed and who has not prayed. With this Azan time and Qibla finder app, stay true to Adhan’s time for prayer daily. Muslim Personal Prayer Daily Tracker In the Everyday Muslim app, you can set a prayer reminder to meet daily prayer goals. Privately analyze with your Salat tracker and challenge yourself to follow Namaz reminders each day. This personal prayer tracker reminder is made to analyze your daily progress. Muslim Group Prayer Daily Tracker The best feature about this daily prayers tracker app is that it allows you to invite family and friends to see each other daily progress. This feature enables you to track Salat within a group. This way, everyone can easily see your progress and message each other to encourage one another to pray. Messenger to Encourage Your Friends or Family to Pray Use our group prayer daily tracker and encourage your friends and family to recite Salat every day. Remind encourage by personally sending a message via the Everyday Muslim app to remind your friends and family about their Islamic praying duties. When you input the details correctly every day, the Everyday Muslim app will remind you of daily Sunnah and show you your progress so far. Sunnah Forgotten Habit Challenge If you fear that you’re not completing daily Sunnah, challenge yourself with our Sunnah habits daily tracker. The Everyday Muslim app challenges you to complete daily Sunnah habits every day through the Sunnah habits daily tracker chart. Muslim Habits Get to know more about your Muslim habits through our Muslim app for prayers. See your Salat tracker progress and daily Sunnah habits when using our app. Our Everyday Muslim app will motivate you, remind you of your duties as a faithful Muslim and encourage you to follow the pillars of Islam- Salat. Islamic Habits Become a faithful Muslim when you follow the pillars of Islam, pray daily, and excel in your prayer challenge. If you don’t know how to pray Salah? descriptionHTML:
It’s hard to monitor our prayers daily, but not with our prayer tracker Everyday Muslim app. Let me introduce you to Everyday Muslim: Salah Tracker, a prayer tracker app. The primary purpose of the Everyday Muslim app is to help users become more resilient towards Muslim prayer times and Quran recitation through daily prayer challenges.

The Everday Muslim app allows for tracking your prayers privately, or you can invite family and friends to see each other's daily progress in a group. One of the key features of the app is that you can see who has prayed and who has not prayed.

You can remind & encourage each other to pray by personally sending a message via the app.

Main features:
With our Everyday Muslim app, get prayer reminder, daily prayers tracker, prayer challenge, Namaz reminder, Azan time and Qibla direction finder, Azan prayer time, Quran reading and translation, Sunnah habits daily tracker.

Adhan
If you’re struggling to remember Azan prayer time, then this Adhan time for prayer app is for you. Our Islamic prayer app will send you Azan prayer time to know it beforehand when you use it. With this Azan time and Qibla finder app, stay true to Adhan’s time for prayer daily.

Muslim Personal Prayer Daily Tracker
In the Everyday Muslim app, you can set a prayer reminder to meet daily prayer goals. Privately analyze with your Salat tracker and challenge yourself to follow Namaz reminders each day. This personal prayer tracker reminder is made to analyze your daily progress.

Muslim Group Prayer Daily Tracker
The best feature about this daily prayers tracker app is that it allows you to invite family and friends to see each other daily progress. This feature enables you to track Salat within a group. This way, everyone can easily see your progress and message each other to encourage one another to pray.

Messenger to Encourage Your Friends or Family to Pray
Use our group prayer daily tracker and encourage your friends and family to recite Salat every day. Remind encourage by personally sending a message via the Everyday Muslim app to remind your friends and family about their Islamic praying duties.

Sunnah Forgotten Habits Daily Tracker
Our Sunnah habits daily tracker app reminds its users to track daily Sunnah. When you input the details correctly every day, the Everyday Muslim app will remind you of daily Sunnah and show you your progress so far.

Sunnah Forgotten Habit Challenge
If you fear that you’re not completing daily Sunnah, challenge yourself with our Sunnah habits daily tracker. The Everyday Muslim app challenges you to complete daily Sunnah habits every day through the Sunnah habits daily tracker chart.

Muslim Habits
Get to know more about your Muslim habits through our Muslim app for prayers. See your Salat tracker progress and daily Sunnah habits when using our app. Our Everyday Muslim app will motivate you, remind you of your duties as a faithful Muslim and encourage you to follow the pillars of Islam- Salat.

Islamic Habits
Become a faithful Muslim when you follow the pillars of Islam, pray daily, and excel in your prayer challenge. If you don’t know how to pray Salah?

Quran
By using this Quran recitation app daily, you can easily recite Quran anytime and anywhere. Our Everyday Muslim app makes Quran reading and translation easy with many Quran reciters. Easily find the reciter you want and get on to your track of Quran recitation daily.

Qibla
With our Muslim prayer times app, you can access an accurate qibla finder for Namaz for free.

How to Pray Salah?
Praying 5 times a day is extremely easy through our Salat tracker app. If you don’t know how to pray Salah? Or how to perform Wudu step by step? Then use our Everyday Muslim app and get detailed instructions to do it.

Follow us on:
https://www.instagram.com/everydaymuslim_app/
